summary.en: Brighton beat Manchester City 1-0 at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday, with Yasin Ayari scoring the only goal in the 11th minute after pouncing on Matheus Nunes' miscued clearance. It was City's second straight Premier League defeat — their first back-to-back league losses since August 2025 — though Enzo Maresca's side stay top of the table. The win was Brighton's first ever at the Etihad; the Seagulls climb to third, two points behind City and Arsenal, who can go top with victory at Liverpool on Sunday.

The victory lifts Freiburg to third in the table.

summary.en: Arsenal missed the chance to move eight points clear at the top of the Premier League after being held to a frustrating 0-0 draw by Liverpool at the Emirates. The Gunners had the better of the first half but Conor Bradley struck the woodwork for Liverpool after a mix-up between David Raya and William Saliba; Dominik Szoboszlai's free-kick sailed just over in the second half. Gabriel Martinelli was booked in stoppage time for pushing the injured Bradley, who left on a stretcher. Arsenal's seven-match winning run ends but they stay six points clear; Liverpool remain fourth, unbeaten in ten.

summary.en: Lewis Hamilton took pole position for the Mexico City Grand Prix with a 1:16.514, just 0.009 seconds ahead of Mercedes' George Russell, with Charles Leclerc third for Ferrari, Max Verstappen fourth and Lando Norris sixth. Championship leader Andrea Kimi Antonelli, 123 points clear, needs only a ninth-place finish in tonight's race (4 a.m. HKT Monday) to seal the drivers' title with three rounds to spare. Russell leads Hamilton by a single point in the fight for second.

summary.en: Tottenham beat 10-man Crystal Palace 2-0 at home for a third straight Premier League win, climbing to eighth. Jean-Philippe Mateta saw red in the 13th minute for a studs-up challenge on Micky van de Ven after a VAR review, and Archie Gray headed the opener from a corner 12 minutes later. Jan Paul van Hecke's scrappy second-half finish sealed it — Spurs' first three-game league winning run since February 2025. Palace slump to third-bottom after a third straight league defeat, with Mateta suspended for the next three games and boss Pierre Sage under mounting pressure.

summary.en: Harry Kane endured a frustrating first outing since winning the Ballon d'Or as Bayern Munich drew 2-2 with Borussia Dortmund in the Klassiker. Kane hit a penalty against the crossbar and struck the post with another effort, but did set up Dayot Upamecano's header for Bayern's second goal. Fabio Silva's 89th-minute strike rescued a point for Dortmund. The draw keeps Bayern and Dortmund locked together at the top of the Bundesliga.

summary.en: Diego Moreira inspired AC Milan to a 3-1 derby win over Inter at San Siro, inflicting the league leaders' first Serie A defeat of the season and a fourth straight Derby della Madonnina victory for the Rossoneri. Moreira set up Christian Pulisic's 4th-minute header and Adrien Rabiot's 10th-minute strike before curling in a free-kick himself in the 43rd minute. Alessandro Bastoni headed Inter's reply in the 22nd minute, while Mike Maignan made a string of fine saves and the referee overturned a late Inter penalty after a VAR review.

Manuel Pellegrini's side controlled nearly 59% of possession in the victory.

summary.en: Hong Kong's Coleman Wong faces France's Terence Atmane in the Seoul Challenger final this afternoon, bidding for his second Challenger title of the season. The career-high world No. 87 has not dropped a set all week, beating Sanhui Shin, Stefanos Sakellaridis, defending champion Sho Shimabukuro and Omar Jasika. Atmane eased past Britain's Billy Harris 6-3 6-1 in the semifinals. The pair meet for the fourth time, with Atmane leading the head-to-head 2-1. Wong lost last year's final to Shimabukuro and is chasing redemption.

summary.en: The 2026-2027 HKSSF fencing individual championships opened at Hong Kong Park Sports Centre yesterday, with 16-year-old Chan Chun-lam of Hong Kong Stanford American School beating Siu Hin-ki of Cheung Sha Wan Catholic Secondary School 15-8 in the Kowloon A Grade boys' foil final for a third straight schools crown. Chan revealed that, encouraged by former Hong Kong star and coach Cheung Siu-lun, he will turn full-time athlete in November and targets a medal at next year's Asian Youth Games. DBS's Tsui Kai-chit and Ip Shing-chi won the epee and sabre titles.
summary.zh_hans: 「2026-2027港九区中学校际剑击比赛」个人赛昨日于香港公园体育馆开打，香港斯坦福美国学校的陈峻霖在九龙区A Grade男子花剑决赛以15:8击退长沙湾天主教英文中学的萧衍祺，连续三年在学界封王。这名16岁小将透露，在前港队名将、教练张小伦鼓励下，将于11月转为全职运动员，盼在剑击路上走得更远，并以明年亚少赛争牌为目标。同日男拔的徐啓哲及叶诚治分夺男子重剑及佩剑冠军。
summary.zh_hant: 「2026-2027港九區中學校際劍擊比賽」個人賽昨日於香港公園體育館開打，香港斯坦福美國學校的陳峻霖在九龍區A Grade男子花劍決賽以15:8擊退長沙灣天主教英文中學的蕭衍祺，連續三年在學界封王。這名16歲小將透露，在前港隊名將、教練張小倫鼓勵下，將於11月轉為全職運動員，盼在劍擊路上走得更遠，並以明年亞少賽爭牌為目標。同日男拔的徐啓哲及葉誠治分奪男子重劍及佩劍冠軍。

summary.en: British-trained Docklands, handled by Harry Eustace, will come to Hong Kong for the Jockey Club Cup on November 22 before connections decide which Hong Kong International Races target to pursue. The former Champions Mile third has been below his best since returning to Britain, and his trainer hopes a run at Sha Tin will bring him back to form. A good Jockey Club Cup run keeps him in Hong Kong for the internationals; otherwise the Hong Kong Mile could be the fallback. (Source: Hong Kong Jockey Club)
summary.zh_hans: 由英国练马师游孝廉训练的「港边小区」（Docklands）将于11月22日来港出战马会杯，再决定在香港国际赛事中角逐哪一项赛事。这匹曾于冠军一哩赛跑获季军的赛驹，返回英国后表现未如理想，练马师希望在沙田一试身手；若马会杯表现正常将继续留港出战国际赛，否则或转战香港一哩锦标赛。（消息来源：香港赛马会）

summary.en: The 2026 Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Youth Football Exchange opened yesterday at Macau's Olympic Sports Centre, with six youth teams from the three regions competing in round-robin Groups A and B. Hong Kong impressed in Group A on day one while Guangdong won in Group B; hosts Macau lost to Hong Kong and Guangdong respectively in the afternoon session. The action continues this morning with Macau facing Guangdong and Hong Kong.

summary.en: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. Morgan Rogers broke the deadlock five minutes after half-time with a solo run and delicate finish; Lisandro Martinez was sent off for two quick yellows — the second for raising an arm to Wesley Fofana, conceding a penalty that Cole Palmer converted for his 50th Premier League goal. United are winless in nine in all competitions, their longest run since September 1984, and sit a point above the drop zone with Michael Carrick's future in doubt; Chelsea climb above Liverpool into fourth.
summary.zh_hant: 車路士在英超主場2:0擊敗曼聯。摩根·羅渣斯換邊後五分鐘單騎闖關射入打開紀錄；利辛度·馬天尼斯三分鐘內連領兩黃被逐，兼送出十二碼，彭馬操刀命中鎖定勝局，個人英超入球達50球里程碑。曼聯各項賽事九場不勝，創1984年9月以來最長頹勢，僅高出降班區一分，領隊卡里克帥位再受壓；車路士升上第四。
summary.zh_hans: 车路士在英超主场2:0击败曼联。摩根·罗渣斯换边后五分钟单骑闯关射入打开纪录；利辛度·马天尼斯三分钟内连领两黄被逐，兼送出十二码，彭马操刀命中锁定胜局，个人英超入球达50球里程碑。曼联各项赛事九场不胜，创1984年9月以来最长颓势，仅高出降班区一分，领队卡里克帅位再受压；车路士升上第四。

title.en: Chelsea beat 10-man Manchester United 2-0 as Martinez sees red

summary.en: Barcelona thrashed Alaves 6-1 at Camp Nou to return to the top of La Liga. Raphinha (8', 41') and Lamine Yamal (45+1', 64') scored twice each, with Fermin Lopez (23') and substitute Anthony Gordon (81') also on target; Mariano Diaz (84') grabbed a late consolation. Barca led 4-0 at the break and sit on 30 points, two clear of Atletico Madrid, bouncing back from their Clasico defeat.
summary.zh_hant: 巴塞隆拿在西甲主場6:1大炒艾拉維斯，重返榜首。拉芬拿（8'、41'）與耶馬（45+1'、64'）各入兩球，費明·盧比斯（23'）及後備上陣的安東尼·哥頓（81'）錦上添花；馬里安奴·戴亞斯（84'）為客軍破蛋。巴塞半場已遙遙領先4:0，以30分兩分力壓馬體會居首，一掃國家打吡落敗的頹氣。

summary.en: The inaugural Northern Metropolis Marathon was held this morning with around 15,000 participants. Organised by the Heung Yee Kuk, the event featured full marathon, half marathon, 10km and 1600m races, with the full marathon starting at the Heung Yee Kuk Building in Shek Mun, Sha Tin. Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak and Heung Yee Kuk chairman Lau Ip-keung sounded the starting gun. The Fanling Bypass served as the finish for the first time, with routes passing the Hong Kong Science Park waterfront, Tolo Highway and Lung Shan Tunnel.
summary.zh_hant: 首屆北部都會區馬拉松今早舉行，約1.5萬人參與。賽事由鄉議局主辦，設全馬、半馬、十公里及1600米四個項目，全馬在沙田石門鄉議局大樓起步，由民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟及鄉議局主席劉業強主持鳴槍。粉嶺繞道首次開放作賽道終點，路線途經香港科學園海濱、吐露港公路及龍山隧道。
summary.zh_hans: 首届北部都会区马拉松今早举行，约1.5万人参与。赛事由乡议局主办，设全马、半马、十公里及1600米四个项目，全马在沙田石门乡议局大楼起步，由民政及青年事务局局长麦美娟及乡议局主席刘业强主持鸣枪。粉岭绕道首次开放作赛道终点，路线途经香港科学园海滨、吐露港公路及龙山隧道。

title.en: Inaugural Northern Metropolis Marathon draws 15,000 runners

summary.en: The 2026 Greater Bay Area Youth Fun Run was held yesterday in Panyu, Guangzhou, drawing nearly 600 young people and families from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao. Marking Jinan University's 120th anniversary, the event was co-organised by the Fok Ying Tung Group's Nam Tin Ming Yuen club, the JNU Alumni Association, Victoria Harbour Education Group and JNU's Hong Kong-Macau children's school, with Su Bingtian firing the starting gun. Races included a 3km parent-child fun run and a 6km elite race across three age groups.

summary.en: The Philadelphia 76ers beat the Charlotte Hornets 109-104 on the road to move to 6-1. Tyrese Maxey poured in a season-high 38 points, including 15 in the fourth quarter; Anfernee Simons added 19 off the bench and Jaylen Brown scored 16. The Sixers rested LeBron James and Joel Embiid on the second night of a back-to-back after Friday's 98-93 NBA Cup win over the defending-champion Knicks and still prevailed. Grayson Allen led Charlotte with 27 off the bench, Brandon Miller added 24.
summary.zh_hant: 費城76人作客109:104擊敗夏洛特黃蜂，開季戰績6勝1負。泰利斯·麥斯攻入賽季新高38分，包括第四節15分；安芬尼·西蒙斯後備貢獻19分，謝倫·布朗得16分。76人在背靠背第二晚輪休勒邦·占士與祖爾·安碧迪（前一晚NBA盃98:93勝衛冕冠軍紐約人），仍能作客取勝。黃蜂方面，格雷森·阿倫後備得27分，布蘭登·米拿24分。
summary.zh_hans: 费城76人作客109:104击败夏洛特黄蜂，开季战绩6胜1负。泰利斯·麦斯攻入赛季新高38分，包括第四节15分；安芬尼·西蒙斯后备贡献19分，谢伦·布朗得16分。76人在背靠背第二晚轮休勒邦·占士与祖尔·安碧迪（前一晚NBA杯98:93胜卫冕冠军纽约人），仍能作客取胜。黄蜂方面，格雷森·阿伦后备得27分，布兰登·米拿24分。

title.en: Maxey drops 38 as 76ers beat Hornets 109-104 without James and Embiid
